note:
SUPERSEDED, kept as evidence rather than deleted.

docs/64's first sweep, taken before the `sparse` and `runs` arms existed: five encodings
(ascii, ruler, coords, code, relative). When the two arms were added the whole sweep was
re-taken rather than extended, so that no table sets arms from different runs side by side --
and the re-take overwrote this file in records/.

It is kept because docs/64 §2.3 RETRACTS a conclusion drawn from it: `monster_count`'s AUC
falling from 0.926 (ascii) to 0.781 (coords), read at the time as 'coordinates break counting'.
A retraction whose evidence cannot be regenerated is a claim nobody can check, and until this
copy existed the only way to regenerate it was to check out an old commit.

The rows are byte-identical to the file as committed in `commit`; only this header was added.
NEVER POOLED with records/*.json -- it is a different run of a different set of arms.
`npx tsx src/spatial.ts --report --superseded` reads this directory and nothing else.
